title: CSV status distribution chart
prompt: Create a PNG bar chart of the event status distribution from the CSV stream we just inspected. Tell me where it was saved and what field was plotted.
expected: Visualization resolves the prior CSV context and plots the status field.
why: Exercises a CSV analysis-to-visualization handoff and verifies that charting is not limited to Parquet dashboards.

metadata.route_reason: The user requested a PNG bar chart from the current CSV file, which matches the visualization expert's CSV bar chart capability.

expert_handoffs.input_summary: Create a PNG bar chart of the event status distribution from the CSV stream we just inspected. Tell me where it was saved and what field was plotted. Use this file from the current session: /home/jcernuda/clio-agent/tmp/clio-benchmark-data/sensor_events.csv
expert_handoffs.output_summary: Generated a PNG bar chart showing the distribution of values in the `status` field from `/home/jcernuda/clio-agent/tmp/clio-benchmark-data/sensor_events.csv`. A bar chart was chosen because `status` is categorical and the goal was to compare event status frequencies.

presets.label: ALCF Metis (Globus Auth)
presets.description: Argonne's Metis inference gateway (FastCoE 'api' framework, OpenAI-compatible chat-completions). Useful fallback when Sophia is in maintenance; typically loads gpt-oss-120b and Llama-4-Maverick. Same Globus tokens as Sophia/Polaris.

presets.label: ALCF Sophia (Globus Auth)
presets.description: Argonne's Sophia inference gateway (vLLM, OpenAI-compatible). Auth is a Globus access token minted on demand from the user's anl.gov / alcf.anl.gov identity. Run `python -m clio_agent.providers.argonne_auth authenticate` once per machine; tokens auto-refresh.

presets.label: Anthropic API
presets.description: Direct Anthropic API. Requires an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

presets.label: Claude Code (subscription)
presets.description: Routes through the local `claude` CLI (`claude -p`) so calls use Claude Code subscription auth instead of direct Anthropic API keys. Requires Claude Code on PATH and `claude login` done once per machine. Implemented as a LiteLLM CustomLLM with Claude Code tools disabled.

presets.label: LM Studio (localhost)
presets.description: Locally-hosted models via LM Studio. Clear the model field to auto-discover the loaded model from /v1/models.

presets.label: Ollama (localhost)
presets.description: Locally-hosted models via Ollama.

presets.label: OpenAI / ChatGPT
presets.description: Direct OpenAI API (powers ChatGPT + Codex CLI). Requires an OPENAI_API_KEY. Defaults to gpt-4o-mini for low cost; swap in gpt-4o or gpt-4-turbo for heavier work.

presets.label: OpenAI Codex (subscription)
presets.description: Routes through the local `codex` CLI (`codex exec`) so calls hit your ChatGPT / Codex subscription instead of paying per-token on the OpenAI API. Requires the Codex CLI on PATH and `codex login` done once per machine. Implemented as a LiteLLM CustomLLM - no HTTP bridge process needed.

presets.label: OpenRouter
presets.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway over many providers. Free tier models (suffixed :free) work without spend but are heavily rate-limited.

presets.label: vLLM (localhost)
presets.description: Any local OpenAI-compatible vLLM server. No Globus needed; the server commonly accepts the literal 'EMPTY' API key. Override api_base with the bound port.

stream_fallback.description: The configured provider does not expose a live streaming contract.

title: Dirty data dashboard after quality review
prompt: Create a compact dashboard PNG for the dirty Parquet export we just reviewed. Use it to support the quality review, and tell me where the artifact was saved.
expected: Visualization resolves the reviewed dirty Parquet file from memory and creates a real dashboard artifact.
why: Stresses multi-turn analysis-to-visualization over intentionally dirty data, not only clean demo fixtures.

metadata.route_reason: The user requests a PNG dashboard artifact for the current Parquet file, which matches the visualization expert's Parquet plotting capability.

expert_handoffs.input_summary: Create a compact dashboard PNG for the dirty Parquet export we just reviewed. Use it to support the quality review, and tell me where the artifact was saved. Use this file from the current session: /home/jcernuda/clio-agent/tmp/clio-benchmark-data/facility_measurements_dirty.parquet
expert_handoffs.output_summary: The generated PNG is a compact dataset summary dashboard showing data type composition, null counts, numeric distributions, and numeric correlation structure. This chart type was chosen because it provides a quick visual overview of schema shape and quality issues in the dirty Parquet export.
